reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-07). This is best explained by a change to billing import validation rules around August causing miscalculated bills even for accounts with accepted ACTUAL reads, since disputed bills are dominated by ACTUAL read type (1785 vs 1240 ESTIMATED, E-01) rather than concentrated among estimate-substitution bills, which weighs against AMI-failure, field-handoff, and staffing-driven mechanisms.

This is best explained by a change to billing import validation rules around August causing miscalculated bills even for accounts with accepted ACTUAL reads, since disputed bills are dominated by ACTUAL read type (1785 vs 1240 ESTIMATED, E-01) rather than concentrated among estimate-substitution bills, which weighs against AMI-failure, field-handoff, and staffing-driven mechanisms.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
